record.Description: This recall involves Fidlock Hermetic dry bags. The medium-sized, watertight plastic bags are clear and measure about 8 inches tall by 4.6 inches wide. They have a blue closure strip with magnets at the top and a black lanyard. “Fidlock” is printed in white on the front of the strip and lot number 2409140930201 is on the back. “Hermetic” is printed on the product packaging.
record.Title: Fidlock GmbH Recalls Hermetic Dry Bags Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Magnet Ingestion Hazard
record.ConsumerContact: Fidlock USA toll-free at 888-303-8332 from 8:30 a.m. to 5 p.m. ET, Monday through Friday, email at recall_2608@fidlock.com, or online at www.fidlock.us/pages/recall or www.fidlock.us and click on “More Recall Information” for more information.

Retailers.Name:
Sold At:
Sports, water sports and outdoor stores nationwide and online at Fidlock.us and Amazon.com from January 2025 through September 2026 for between $30 and $35.

Hazards.Name: The recalled bags’ adhesive closure strips can detach, causing the magnets to fall out, posing a risk of serious injury or death from a magnet ingestion hazard.

Remedies.Name: Consumers should stop using the bags immediately and contact Fidlock USA to receive a replacement bag or a gift card for the Fidlock USA online shop. Customers who purchased the product from the FIDLOCK online store can receive a full refund in the form of a credit card refund or PayPal refund. Consumers will be asked to go to www.fidlock.us/pages/recall and send a photo of the product. Consumers should then dispose of the recalled product.

ai.summary: Fidlock GmbH has recalled approximately 490 Hermetic Dry Bags because the adhesive closure strips can detach and release loose magnets. If these magnets fall out and are swallowed, they pose a serious injury or death hazard.
ai.next_steps: Immediately stop using the product and go to www.fidlock.us/pages/recall to submit a photo of the bag, then throw it away. Contact Fidlock USA to claim a replacement bag, an online store gift card, or a full refund if you purchased it directly from the FIDLOCK online store.
